The '''Cloud City Miner's Guild''', also known as the '''Cloud City Mining Guild''', was an organization that controlled aspects of the [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna gas]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].
